New China Daily News published the following editorial on
October 19 :-

THE QUESTION OF JURISDICTION OVER THE PROPERTY OF THE
LATE MRS. HARDOON

The death of the late Mrs. Hardoon
has given rise to a family dispute and to the question of
the nationality of the deceased.
The late Mr. Hardoon was a model of
Shanghai adventurers. He was a wandering Jew from Iraq
who had amassed a huge fortune not from work but by
oppressing the people. He relied upon two things ---
opium and land. He became rich by the favourable
opportunities presented by the opening of Shanghai as a
Far Eastern colony of the British and American Imperialists.
None of the fortunes made by other British and American
Imperialists in Shanghai can be compared with that of
Hardoon's. Most of the early adventurers returned home
after achieving some success. Those who remained in
Shanghai --- such as Sassoon, Keswick, etc --- to suck the
blood of the people cannot be driven away because they have
their countries to rely upon and because the Chinese
compradore system has not yet been done away with. Hardoon,
a wandering Jew, obtained his British nationality through his
dirty gold; but he had no motherland to return to. He
married a Chinese wife but had no children. Since his
death, his property was controlled by his widow, because
he had willed all his property to her. This fact is
recognized by the British.
Ten years ago, a Palestine Jew said to
be a near relative of Hardoon contested the will in the
British Court on the ground that, according to Jewish
custom, only the relative of the same blood can have the
right to inherit property. But the British Court decided
that as Hardoon had been naturalized as a British subject,
his property must be settled according to British law, and
recognized the right of his Chinese wife to inherit the
property.
P. T. O.

《新中国日报》于10月19日发表以下社论：

关于已故哈同夫人财产的管辖权问题

已故哈同夫人的去世引发了家庭纠纷以及死者国籍问题。
已故哈同先生是上海冒险家的典型。他是一个来自伊拉克的流浪犹太人，并非通过劳动，而是通过压迫人民积累了巨额财富。他依靠两样东西——鸦片和土地。他利用上海作为英美帝国主义者在远东的殖民地开放所带来的有利时机致富。其他英美帝国主义者在上海积累的财富都无法与哈同相比。大多数早期冒险家在取得一定成功后便回国了。那些留在上海的人——如沙逊、凯锡克等——为了榨取人民的血汗而不愿离开，因为他们有各自的国家作为靠山，且中国的买办制度尚未废除。哈同，一个流浪犹太人，用他不义之财获得了英国国籍；但他没有祖国可回。他娶了一位中国妻子，但没有子女。自他去世后，他的财产由其遗孀控制，因为他将所有财产都遗嘱赠予了她。这一事实得到英国的承认。
十年前，一名据称是哈同近亲的巴勒斯坦犹太人在英国法院对遗嘱提出异议，理由是依照犹太习俗，只有同血缘亲属才有权继承财产。但英国法院裁定，由于哈同已归化为英国臣民，其财产必须依照英国法律处理，并承认其中国妻子继承财产的权利。

南京方面制止罢工
据昨日《新顺报》刊登的一篇新闻采访
披露，南京新政权代表将试图防止上海
发生罢工，以便在不给公众造成不便的
情况下解决劳资纠纷。该报引用了南京
社会部长丁默村先生的话。
据说丁先生已命令上海的社会运动委员
会防止罢工，并首先尝试调解。
据称，丁先生非常关心上海的治安秩序，
凡是不听官员劝告而煽动罢工者将被捕。
在解决劳资纠纷时，应仔细考虑雇主和
雇员双方的不满。

Liu

7-8-40 P.M.

Chinese-American Daily News :-

Local Trades Pay no Attention to Puppet Order.

During the past few days local trade bodies have received from the puppet Ministry of Social Affairs an "Order of Instruction" and a "Merchant Investigation Form" with instructions that the various trade bodies fill in the particulars wanted. The attempt of the puppet party failed as the various trades firmly refused to observe the order.

On August 6, an "Order of Instruction" of the puppet Social Movement Direction Committee of the Ministry of Social Affairs was received by these trade bodies. The nature of this "Order of Instruction" is most absurd, for it threatens that severe punishment will be imposed upon those who fail to fill in and return the Investigation Form within three days.

A leading person in a certain trade was asked for his opinion about the "Order of Instruction" by a reporter of the Dah Kwan News Agency (大光報) yesterday.

In reply, he stated that his trade was a lawful organization and would always obey lawful orders, but there was no reason for it to obey the illegal "Order of Instruction" issued by the puppet organization. Though the circumstances prevailing in Shanghai at present were unfavourable, his trade would maintain its proper stand to the end, and that neither threats nor any kind of action could shake its firm determination.

Enquiries were also made by the reporter among other trades, and it was learned that they also would pay no heed to the "Order of Instruction" issued by the puppet Ministry of Social Affairs.

《中美日報》：

本地商界無視偽政權命令。

過去幾天，本地各行業團體收到了偽社會部發出的「訓令」和「商人調查表」，指示各業界團體填寫所需資料。由於各行業堅決拒絕遵守該命令，偽方的企圖未能得逞。

8月6日，這些行業團體收到了偽社會部社會運動指導委員會的「訓令」。這份「訓令」的性質極為荒謬，因為它威脅稱，凡未在三天內填寫並交回調查表者，將受到嚴厲懲罰。

《大光報》記者昨日就該「訓令」徵詢了某一行業領頭人的意見。

他回答說，他的行業是合法組織，始終遵守合法命令，但沒有理由遵守偽組織發出的非法「訓令」。儘管目前上海的局勢不利，但他的行業將堅持正確立場到底，任何威脅或行動都無法動搖其堅定決心。

記者還向其他行業進行了查詢，得知他們也不會理會偽社會部發出的「訓令」。

SOCIAL MOVEMENT DIRECTION COMMITTEE OF THE MINISTRY OF
SOCIAL AFFAIRS OF NANKING GOVERNMENT TO INVESTIGATE
VARIOUS PUBLIC BODIES.

The Social Movement Direction Committee of
the Ministry of Social Affairs of the Nanking Government is
the only directing and supervisory organization of public
bodies in the whole of China. It is responsible for
improving social movements and for organizing and training
the people.

Since the formation of this Committee,
Branch Committees have been established in Shanghai, Nanking,
Soochow and Hangchow.

The Shanghai Municipality Branch Committee
was established three months ago. Owing to the high prices
of commodities, many labour disputes have occurred in Shanghai.
Many labour disputes were settled as a result of mediation
undertaken by this Committee.

(沈明之), Sun Ming-chi (沈明之) and Chang Kuh-chong
(張固忠), the Chief and Deputy Chief of the Shanghai
Municipality Branch Committee respectively, are responsible
for affairs in Shanghai. They have an office at No. 75
Jossfield Road.

It is learned that the following order of
instruction with character "Ts" (特) was recently received
by the Shanghai Municipality Branch Committee from the Social
Movement Direction Committee of the Ministry of Social Affairs
of the Nanking Government :-

"In order to make clear the position of
the various public bodies in the provinces, municipalities and
hsiens and to facilitate recording, 1,000 Public Bodies
Investigation Forms are herewith forwarded to the Shanghai
Municipality Branch Committee with orders to start
investigations at once. These Forms should be returned
within one month but not earlier than three days after they
are received."

Upon receipt of the order, the Shanghai
Municipality Branch Committee instructed its various sections
to hasten their investigations into the social bodies in
Shanghai.

Date May 20, 1940.
Subject Shanghai Branch of the Social Movement Direction Committee of the
Ministry of Social Affairs of the New Central Government at Nanking.
Made by and Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

The Social Movement Direction Committee of the
Ministry of Social Affairs of the New Central Government
at Nanking recently established a Shanghai Branch at 75
Jessfield Road, for the purpose of undertaking the
supervision, direction, organization and training of all
local public bodies. WANG MAI YUNG (江曼雲), a member
of the Central Executive Committee of Wang Ching Wei
sponsored Kuomintang, is in charge of the Branch, and
there are six departments, namely,
(1) Agricultural Department (2) Industrial Department
(3) Commercial Department (4) Women's Department
(5) Youths Department and (6) Special Department.
The Branch at 75 Jessfield Road, however, has
not as yet started functioning but arrangements are
being made by WANG MAI YUNG in order to select suitable
persons to take charge of the various departments.
It is learned that the establishment of the
Shanghai Branch of the Social Movement Direction
Committee is connected with the reorganization scheme
of the Special Service Corps of the Chung Kuo Kuomintang
Anti-Comintern & National Salvation Army, 76 Jessfield
Road. A number of senior members of this organization
are reported to have been instructed by TING MUH TSUNG
(丁默村), now Minister of Social Affairs of the new
Central Government, to proceed to Nanking before the
end of this month.

Central China Daily News :-
BRANCH OFFICE OF SOCIAL MOVEMENT DIRECTION
COMMITTEE IN SHANGHAI FORMALLY INAUGURATED

In view of the importance of public
movements, the Ministry of Social Affairs has established
a Social Movements Direction Committee (社會運動指導委員會)
to undertake the supervision, direction, organization
and training of public bodies. Branch offices have
been established in municipalities and provinces.
The temporary organization regulations of the Committee
have been passed by the Executive Yuan.
The Branch Office of the Committee in the
Shanghai Municipality was formally inaugurated at No.75
Jessfield Road on May 10. The Branch Office is
divided into six sections, namely an Agricultural
Section, an Industrial Section, a Commercial Section,
a Youths Section, a Women's Section and a Special
Society Section. Many local public bodies have applied
to the Branch Office for registration. People have also
requested the permission of the Branch Office to
organize public bodies.

《华中日报》：
社会运动指导委员会上海分会正式成立

鉴于民众运动的重要性，社会部设立了社会运动指导委员会（社會運動指導委員會），以承担对公共团体的监督、指导、组织和培训工作。在各市和省均设立了分支机构。
该委员会的临时组织条例已通过行政院批准。
该委员会在上海特别市的分会于5月10日在极司菲尔路75号正式成立。分会下设六个科，即农业科、工业科、商业科、青年科、妇女科和特殊社团科。许多地方公共团体已向分会申请注册。人们也请求分会许可组织公共团体。
